edits.before: Late, Mel reclaims the edge. Her Rebuttal reflects your ultimate's damage and stuns you mid-combo, her Solar Flare slow zone peels your dive, and her passive Overwhelm executes low targets after enough stacks — all of which punish the exact all-in you rely on. Into 2+ items, stop solo-diving; flank the fight, only commit once her W is spent, or let a teammate eat the reflect first.
